patch.content:
# Kconfig.defconfig for ARM Cortex-M baseline
#
# Copyright (c) 2016, 2018 Wind River Systems, Inc.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

# set if the CPU has a systick
CONFIG_CPU_CORTEX_M_HAS_SYSTICK=y

# set if the CPU has a DWT
CONFIG_CPU_HAS_DWT=y

# set if the CPU has ARM FPU
CONFIG_CPU_HAS_FPU=y

# set if the CPU has ARM MPU
CONFIG_CPU_HAS_ARM_MPU=y

# ARM is a 32-bit architecture
CONFIG_32BIT=y

# Use the newlib C library
CONFIG_NEWLIB_LIBC=y

# Enable the GCC built-in functions
CONFIG_COMPILER_BUILTIN_FUNCS=y

# Enable toolchain-provided C library
CONFIG_TOOLCHAIN_SUPPORTS_LIBC=y

initial_error_log:
[Kconfig/Configuration Error Detected]
warning: MAX_THREAD_BYTES (defined at arch/Kconfig:463) was assigned the value '8' but got the value
''. Check these unsatisfied dependencies: USERSPACE (=n). See
http://docs.zephyrproject.org/latest/kconfig.html#CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES and/or look up
MAX_THREAD_BYTES in the menuconfig/guiconfig interface. The Application Development Primer, Setting
Configuration Values, and Kconfig - Tips and Best Practices sections of the manual might be helpful
too.
